name: "Viva o Porto, Viva Portugal"
description: Explore a vibrant tribute to the people and traditions of Porto through the paintings of artist Sérgio Remondes.
longDescription:
"Viva o Porto, Viva Portugal" is an art exhibition at the Clérigos Museum, featuring the work of artist Sérgio Remondes. The exhibition presents a collection of paintings that focus on the inhabitants and cultural practices of Porto, offering a visual exploration of the city's identity and its connection to Portugal. The works aim to document and celebrate the everyday life and enduring traditions found within the city.

Visitors to the exhibition will encounter a series of artworks displayed within the historic setting of the Clérigos Museum. The exhibition runs for one week, from October 8th to October 14th, 2026. The atmosphere is intended to be reflective, allowing for contemplation of the depicted scenes and figures. The venue, a prominent landmark, provides a grand backdrop for the displayed art.

Admission to "Viva o Porto, Viva Portugal" is ticketed. The Clérigos Museum is centrally located and accessible by public transport; it is a short walk from the São Bento train station and the Aliados metro station.
